description: Multi-service selection by Host (MCPWARP.md §4.8 step 2): no X-Mcpwarp-Server-Id, so the agent takes the first Host label, b-svc-alice, and splits it at its LAST hyphen: service name b-svc (a service name may hold inner hyphens), username alice (^[a-z0-9]{3,20}$, never a hyphen). b-svc is held and active, so its handler serves the request; a-svc's is not called.
in:
POST /mcp HTTP/1.1
Host: b-svc-alice.tunnel.example
accept: application/json, text/event-stream
content-type: application/json
user-agent: Go-http-client/1.1
Content-Length: 40

{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"ping"}
out:
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
content-type: application/json
Transfer-Encoding: chunked

28
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"ping"}
0
notes: The label is lowercased and a :port on Host is dropped before the split. The runner checks that only routedTo's handler instance was called.
